   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 19, 2026 - Aug 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Galih Herprasetyo_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Notion AI, at first it is good, but recently the AI keep not finishing it's answer, or even worse not answering at all. it only "thinking" "noodling" but the progress usually stop, tell me "no internet connection" when I 10000% sure internet is not the issue here. soooo frustrating. please fix this asap"
            2. _holo hooligan_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "i cant tell u how many hours..days were spent trying to get the database working... the website has bugs but the phone version is hell! Everytime i try to edit automation for a button the whole UI justs give up and shifts out of the screen to the point i have to close the app and restart. Sometimes even that doesnt work and it takes ages to load the pages even in the browser"
            3. _J A_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "Unsuable. Copying note from Windows app to Word 1) loses all formatting, inserting weird symbols instead 2) inserts all text as list items. Also bugs 1. if there are no pages inside, expand icon should not be shown 2. removing text from beginning of the page should not switch to page header and remove that text as well. And a bunch of bugs in Windows app"
